title: Why Do Hedgers Hedge? The Role of Ambiguity
summary: No new direction, threshold or return test inferred from hedging-behavior forecasts.
about: Risk and ambiguity as explanations of crude-oil hedging positions.
findings: Abstract/intro say operational hedgers and intermediaries respond oppositely; operational IV evidence is weaker.

build_on: Useful group/measurement caution; own legacy positions do not separate operational hedgers from swap dealers.
